# Book of Giants Fragment 10 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Book of Giants Fragment 10 (Lament of the Giants) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 10:1 — "Woe to us / We are doomed"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Woe to-us for-our-sin" — preserves wai lana |
| LOGOS | "Woe to us for our sin" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "We are doomed because of what we have done" — loses interjection, paraphrases |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "Woe to us for our sin." The Aramaic interjection wai must be preserved; it is the hallmark of lamentation.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:9 — "gates of mercy are shut / door of mercy is slammed shut"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-gates-of mercy are-shut" — literal |
| LOGOS | "the gates of mercy are shut" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "the door of mercy is slammed shut" — singular "door," adds violent verb "slammed" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the gates of mercy are shut." Plural "gates" matches Aramaic; PNEUMA's "slammed" is an interpretive intensification.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:13 — "broken / shattered"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-strength-of our-arms is-broken" — literal |
| LOGOS | "the strength of our arms is broken" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "the might of our arms has been shattered" — intensifies "broken" to "shattered" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "is broken." The Aramaic uses a standard verb for breaking; PNEUMA's "shattered" adds intensity beyond the source.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements for Fragment 10: 3*
